long_biography.plain_text:
During the 2000s, Arnoux turned his Alpine and south-eastern French property work into PureConcept, an international ultra-luxury platform. Its model brought engineering, architectural design and project delivery together, producing tailored residences and chalets rather than standard developments. It later extended that approach to hospitality and commercial schemes.

His design philosophy emphasises site-specific layouts, natural light, local materials and energy systems intended to reduce consumption without diluting finish. The same attention to detail carried into bespoke interiors and furniture, while PureConcept developed a network across Europe, the Gulf and the United States. Arnoux's public identity remains that of the founder-developer who sketches concepts and assembles specialist craftspeople to execute them.

uncertainties.detail: Several unrelated men share the name Eric Arnoux, including a French politician born on 19 January 1966. The resolved person is Eric Henri André Arnoux, born on 19 May 1966 in Grenoble. The exact birth record, PureConcept career and Pure One/D'One plus Pure/Carpe Diem naming chain create a high-confidence bridge to person ID 9691. Vessel details are used only for identity resolution and are excluded from both biographies and wealth classifications.

The owner input gives France as current residence. A 2012 Luxembourg notice records a then-residence in Cologny, Switzerland, and later reporting places Arnoux in Dubai from 2019. None provides a sufficiently current and authoritative basis to replace the upstream France value or add a secondary residence, so no residence proposal is made.

Reviewed sources describe Arnoux founding PureConcept and building property businesses after entering business in 1991. They do not identify an inherited company, pre-existing family asset, succession event, spouse transfer or other legal family-transfer mechanism. Broad Self-made is therefore supported, while Self-made (independent), Inherited, Inherited and expanded and Marriage/family transfer would each require evidence not present in the public record.

PureConcept's site and registry records establish current activity, but no audited revenue, asset value, ownership percentage or reliable personal net-worth estimate was found. The dossier classifies industry and relationship from documented founder control and operating history without quantifying Arnoux's wealth or the platform's current scale.

An exact LinkedIn profile, personal website and current company website are identity-secure and proposed. A public directory also supplies an X handle and Instagram handle, but neither could be independently verified through an accessible exact-person page during this review; they are therefore withheld. No identity-secure Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Wikipedia or other priority social was found.

The mandatory exact-profile and exact-name Forbes searches were performed first and found no dedicated Forbes personal profile for the resolved PureConcept founder. The result is recorded as not_found rather than inferring a profile from mentions or namesakes.

Luxury real estate captures the defining industry specialism and Property developer captures the practiced occupation under separate active semantic dimensions. Architect is excluded because the evidence shows engineering and design work but does not establish a licensed or defining architect identity. Superyacht construction and generic yacht-industry tags are excluded because professional yacht-design commissions are adjacent rather than the documented core of wealth creation or current operations.

review.notes: Terminal resolved-person dossier. Eric Henri André Arnoux is the 19 May 1966 Grenoble-born French founder of PureConcept, with the upstream yacht record linked through exact Pure One/D'One and Pure/Carpe Diem evidence. Real Estate is both wealth-creation and current primary industry, Self-made is the evidence-supported broad origin without an independent-start subtype, and Founder is the present relationship. The dossier fills middle names, known-for title, gender, birthplace, birth country and biography; proposes identity-secure LinkedIn, company and personal websites; and assigns the minimum useful active tags with complete additive semantic fields. No Forbes profile or supported family succession was found, and nothing has been applied to the live owner record.
